scope: Exact three compiled generated setters with inlined native bodies, exact three native update wrappers, native admission/ready leases, native capture/create/original-identity/validate/mark-applied and expected-post logical/physical-prefix anchors, actual native material/mesh callees, and exact compiled property metadata. No source mutation, new build, or device execution.

method.independent_extraction: Fresh LLVM llvm-nm numeric text symbol bounds and llvm-objdump ARM64 instructions through build/audit_hud_macho.py; watcher instructions compared where corresponding original dumps exist. Same-address aliases checked explicitly.
method.metadata: Pinned upstream RNA layout plus compiled classifier loads; actual callback VAs decoded by LLVM --macho --dyld-info from DYLD_CHAINED_PTR_64_OFFSET, never treating raw chained words as ordinary VAs.
method.refusal_walk: Ordinary intraprocedural direct successors from exact gate-refusal targets. Calls are boundaries, known stack-check failure is nonreturning. No whole-program CFG claim.
